entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The land of the animalfolk, a paradise for most of its inhabitants, with Three Tree City among its settlements.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: A city in Valley where animalfolk gathered to welcome an ambassador from outside Valley.

entities.name: Great Maha
entities.description: A Calamity Beast of Valley, named as an example of a calamity that threatened it.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Beasts whose power desperate animalfolk harnessed in Valley's early days, to destructive effect.

entities.name: Decai
entities.description: A squirrelfolk rotmaster who speaks of life and death as a cycle he keeps spinning.

entities.name: Lop
entities.description: A rabbitfolk farmer who fears the Ant Queen's hunger.

entities.name: Ms. Bumbleflower
entities.description: A resident of Valley who tells of an ambassador arriving in Three Tree City.

entities.name: Otho Darkclaw
entities.description: A reformed river pirate of Valley.

entities.name: Ark
entities.description: A lizardfolk blacksmith who speaks of change.

entities.name: Illa
entities.description: An otterfolk scout looking for Fli-fli.

entities.name: Fli-fli
entities.description: A companion of Illa who went out with frogfolk wizards.

entities.name: Rho
entities.description: A veteran hero who counsels finding home where you can.

entities.name: Inspector Jillard
entities.description: An inspector who wishes the city had more divine intervention.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker and leonin who speaks of his brother Jazal as his kha.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Ajani's brother, his kha and source of his inspiration.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A figure who says Ravnicans need order and that her people will bring it.

entities.name: Urdnan
entities.description: A Dromoka warrior who trusts in the scalelords.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who stole the weapon of a god.

entities.name: Bident of Thassa
entities.description: The weapon of the god Thassa, stolen by Kiora.

entities.name: Doriel
entities.description: A mentor of Mistral Isle.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who wanted answers.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: A figure who needed a spy.

entities.name: Etha
entities.description: An initiate of Rhet crop.

entities.name: Alela
entities.description: A speaker who says stolen knowledge is yours forever.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa
entities.description: A fugitive who quotes her ancestor Toshiro and calls herself a master of great bad choices.

entities.name: Toshiro
entities.description: Tetsuko Umezawa's ancestor, who said life is a series of choices between bad and worse.

entities.name: Branko One-Ear
entities.description: A speaker who describes an ogre's vermin-infested tenement.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: A researcher who began his research with magic Strixhaven forbade from the Blood Age.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A school of magic with five colleges that encourage rivalries among students.

entities.name: Lannery Storm
entities.description: A captain whose cannons were destroyed by a walking clock.

entities.name: Arel
entities.description: The Unseen Whisperer, who speaks of Atarka's people.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon whose people starve while she feasts upon their hunts.

entities.name: Euphemia
entities.description: A Nexus watcher who says monsters dwell in every heart.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: A hunter in the Saga of the Wisdom Seeker who hid in the snow to wait for a great eagle.

entities.name: Larrel
entities.description: A Deep Forest hermit addressing friends, foragers and fuzzy fighters.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A planeswalker who calls for a city to be smashed to pieces.

entities.name: Nidd
entities.description: A traveler who crested a peak and found a place to call home.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of a packleader who is willing to share.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: A Golgari lich-lord who sees wisdom in death.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A Mwonvuli recluse who does not welcome humans into her forest.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of the anger of the land.

entities.name: Rishkar
entities.description: A Peema renegade who holds that aether is the soul of Kaladesh.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane whose soul, in Rishkar's words, is aether.

entities.name: Numstail
entities.description: A squirrel who stole the acorn for rule of the Aldering Forest from Nestwind.

entities.name: Jeddeg
entities.description: A philosopher of graves.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Golgari shaman.

entities.name: Joskun
entities.description: An An-Havva constable who claims there are only squirrels in the forest.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who explains temporal study.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: A figure known as the Pretender.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure who speaks of atoning for his failures.

entities.name: Tergel
entities.description: A goblin explosioneer.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who tells Jace that the Eldrazi can be imprisoned.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who asks how imprisoning the Eldrazi worked out last time.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that the hedrons were made to imprison.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Artifacts whose true purpose is imprisoning the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who speaks of mana and of Thran mysteries.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An aether-seer who urges never ceasing to create.

entities.name: Rhmir
entities.description: A Hand of the Augur who calls for more brains.

entities.name: Kenjek
entities.description: Captain of the Thousand Swords.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of the downtrodden rising.

entities.name: Sturwynn
entities.description: A Boundary Lands ranger.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of a place with the words I love what they've done with the place.

entities.name: Alene of Riverspan
entities.description: A resident of Riverspan whose ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship.

entities.name: Josu
entities.description: A young man whose body was never found.

entities.name: Josu's sister
entities.description: The murderous sister of Josu.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between brothers that left Adarkar Wastes barren.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A figure who fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul and whose metathran children were made by machines.

entities.name: The Antiquities War
entities.description: The war of Urza and his brother, recounted in a book of the same name.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A device whose blast marked the end of the war and of Dominaria as most knew it.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: A scholar who saw the sylex as a key to the past.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose technology enraged spiritmongers and whose portal ship was brought down at Riverspan.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The Dominarian alliance whose failure would leave Dominaria barren.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane left barren in places by the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard whose nations united against a common threat.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: A place where a girl became known for mischief with playful spirits.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose people Isperia says need order.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: A dangerous city at night.

events.summary: An ambassador from outside Valley arrives in Three Tree City and animalfolk come from all over to welcome them.
events.quote: An ambassador from outside Valley arrived today in Three Tree City

events.summary: Kiora steals the Bident of Thassa, the weapon of a god.
events.quote: Only Kiora would dare steal the weapon of a god.

events.summary: Elspeth seeks answers while Xander needs a spy, and their paths cross.
events.quote: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy.

events.summary: The sylex blast ends the war and the Dominaria most knew.
events.quote: The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it.

events.summary: Urza fortifies the path to Tomakul every thirty miles, creating trenches the brothers trade for decades.
events.quote: Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul

events.summary: Alene's ancestors bring down a Phyrexian portal ship and build their town on its hull.
events.quote: Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons show the Eldrazi can be imprisoned, and Jace asks how that worked out last time.
The nations of Bant forget their war and stand united against a common threat.
events.quote: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

events.summary: Josu's body and that of his murderous sister are never found.
events.quote: They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister.

relations.note: Ajani calls Jazal his brother and his kha.
relations.quote: As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations.

relations.note: Josu's sister is described as murderous.
relations.quote: They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister.
